scope.target: 411 miRNAs, 271 diseases, five types, 11748 typed triples

deduplication.same_container_sha256: one candidate with multiple discovery entries
deduplication.same_immutable_url_or_commit: one search outcome unless bytes changed
deduplication.same_semantic_digests_different_bytes: retain one candidate family and record all custody paths
deduplication.conflicting_bytes_same_claim: retain separately and escalate to Sol

ladder.name: Publisher supplement and former original repository
services: Oxford Academic article and supplementary assets
query_templates: repository releases, tags, branches, commits, trees, LFS pointers, and downloadable archives
ladder.completion_rule: Record every accessible supplement asset and every repository namespace object or explicit absence/error.

ladder.name: GitHub history, forks, dependencies, and event archives
services: GitHub repository/fork/code/commit APIs or equivalent public pages
query_templates: search archive members and data-loading paths without filename-number assumptions
ladder.completion_rule: Enumerate public forks/history and inspect data-bearing objects, not only default branches or filenames.

ladder.name: Software and web archives
query_templates: origin URL snapshots for the former repository
repository archive and raw-content URL snapshots
known asset filenames and parent-directory captures discovered in L1-L2
ladder.completion_rule: Record origin/snapshot identifiers and inspect recoverable directory or archive contents.

ladder.name: Research-data repositories and alternate code forges
query_templates: paper title, author/project identifiers, and discovered archive filenames
ladder.completion_rule: Record exact queries per service and inspect public downloadable files or immutable metadata records.

ladder.name: Citing and related benchmark implementations
services: public code repositories referenced by citing/related implementations
query_templates: HMDD v3.2 benchmark loaders and preprocessing scripts
files detected by content, shape, tensor axes, entity maps, or loader paths rather than 411/271/11748 in names
ladder.completion_rule: Inspect data dependencies and binary/archive members for provenance-bearing copies; do not broaden to HMDD v4.

execution_rules: Record failed, empty, blocked, and duplicate searches as well as hits.
Download only public in-scope candidates; never commit candidate bytes by default.
Use a non-repository external data root or ignored quarantine directory.
Write downloads to .part, then size/hash and atomically rename.
Do not infer exactness from name, dimensions, density, or final counts.
Do not contact authors, open issues, or send external messages.
Terra stops and returns the complete ledger; Sol performs S1B.
